# Streak Skill for Muse

A universal habit and challenge tracker with flexible cadence (daily, weekly, every N days): check-ins, backlog handling, context files, smart insights, and cross-learning detection that spots patterns across your different challenges — fitness, learning, creating, habits. Honest note: it was written for Claude Code with local context files, so the file-based tracking assumes a coding-agent setup — but the core ritual adapts cleanly into a simple conversation-based tracking routine with your Muse.
